result.title: AGPF: Dynamic Source Selection for Feature Pyramid Fusion
result.summary:
Feature pyramids provide dense predictors with features at several spatial resolutions. However, it remains largely unexplored which pyramid levels each output location should aggregate information from. We investigate this question by allowing each output location to attend to features from every pyramid level and measuring how attention is distributed across scales. Surprisingly, locations on the finest output grid allocate approximately 75\% of their attention to features two levels coarser, rather than to the current or adjacent levels. Even on the same output grid, the balance shifts toward coarser features as object size increases.
  These observations motivate Asymmetric Global Pyramid Fusion (AGPF), a neck that preserves the original output grids while allowing each location to dynamically select its contextual sources across scales. Each location interacts with a multiscale memory whose features are aligned in image coordinates, enabling flexible cross-scale aggregation without altering prediction resolutions. Compared with FPN, AGPF improves all 19 object detection and all seven instance segmentation configurations evaluated on COCO. A single fusion block improves Cascade Mask R-CNN by 1.7 box AP and 2.3 mask AP, and the gains consistently transfer to semantic and panoptic segmentation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察特征金字塔中每个输出位置应聚合哪些尺度层级的信息，发现最细输出网格约 75% 的注意力落在粗两级的特征上，且随目标变大更偏向粗尺度；据此提出 AGPF，在保持原输出网格的前提下让每个位置从图像坐标对齐的多尺度记忆中动态选择上下文来源，在 COCO 检测与多种分割任务上稳定提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「逐位置跨尺度动态选择证据源」及注意力在各尺度上的分布测量，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与内部状态的尺度选择提供借鉴，可供核查该对齐记忆与选择机制能否迁移到 VLM 多层视觉特征的动态路由。
